title: ApprovalDecision
description:
The closed approval vocabulary (evidence and admission wave): every approval gate in the harness decides in these terms and no others.

Exactly one variant grants — [`ApprovalDecision::ApprovedOnce`], with allowed-once semantics: the decision admits the single occurrence it was asked about and is spent by admitting it. Every other outcome denies, so the vocabulary is fail-closed by construction: an unanswered ask (`Unavailable`), a withdrawn ask (`Cancelled`), and a refused ask (`Rejected`) are three different facts with one shared consequence.

oneOf.description: The ask was approved for this occurrence only. The only granting outcome.

approved_by.description: Who approved — a human operator id, a policy name, a token's `approved_by`. Evidence, not authentication.

oneOf.description: A decider considered the ask and refused it.

reason.description: Why, when the decider gave a reason.

oneOf.description: The ask was withdrawn before a decider answered.

reason.description: Why, when the withdrawal gave a reason.

oneOf.description: No decider was available to answer the ask — a missing token, an unreachable approver, a gate with no decision source. Denies, indistinguishable from a refusal at the gate and deliberately distinguishable from one in the evidence.
